questions.implements: Does the diff implement what the repository records for the Jira issue, and add or change a test that checks it? Judge the code in the diff, not the answer.

judge.reason: The diff covers all three parts of R-ORDER-NOTE. PlaceOrder now takes a note. It rejects any note longer than 200 characters with ErrNoteTooLong before pricing, stock reservation or payment, so the order is not placed. A successful order keeps the note in the new Order.Note field. The new test TestPlaceOrderNote checks each of these. A note of exactly 200 characters is accepted and kept on the order. A note of 201 characters returns ErrNoteTooLong, and stock and audit entries stay unchanged, which shows no order was placed. The existing tests were only updated to pass the new argument.

finalMessage:
Implemented SHOP-62. Checkout now accepts an order note, keeps it on the returned order, and rejects notes over 200 Unicode characters before pricing, stock reservation, or payment.

`R-ORDER-NOTE` is now implemented. The change keeps `R-CHECKOUT-ORDER`, `R-CHECKOUT-SESSION`, and `R-STOCK-RELEASE` true. No risk or threat control entry was touched.

`go test ./...` passed, including `TestPlaceOrderNote`, `TestPlaceOrder`, `TestPlaceOrderNeedsSession`, `TestPlaceOrderReleasesStockOnDecline`, and `TestRelease`.
